env-01.description: Verify Blender/MCP environment, preserve baseline scene, initialise owned project scene
env-01.failure: Environment work succeeded but the operation's expected_outputs omitted the saved scene path required by complete --scene; superseded by env-02 checkpoint, no scene damage.

env-02.description: Record verified environment baseline checkpoint with declared scene output
env-02.verification: Verified Blender 5.2.2 LTS, RTX 4060 OptiX device, 31.7GB RAM, 8GB VRAM via live MCP/host queries; baseline default .blend copy exists; Cube/Light/Camera preserved hidden in BASELINE_PRESERVED_DEFAULT; PALAGAN owned collection tree created; viewport OpenGL capture written and read back as an image; saved env-02 scene and inventory.

blockout-01.description: Build M001-derived river, streets, quays, bridge massing, landmark massing and map underlay
blockout-01.verification: Reopened saved scene (55 objects, 52 owned) after host restart. Compared map-only and model-only plan renders side by side; Kali Mas, bridge crossing, Heerenstraat and Kembang Djepoen are broadly aligned with M001 and not mirrored. Inspected overview: blockout intentionally sparse, landmark masses only. Corrected road contrast and replaced the unusable single-pass map overlay with a separate map/model comparison. Remaining: detailed architecture, street fabric, materials and final cameras.

bridge-01.description: Replace bridge massing with detailed low three-span deck, railings, lamps, abutments and steps
bridge-01.verification: Saved bridge-01 checkpoint and inventory (63 scene objects, 60 owned, 9 bridge meshes). Re-rendered CAM_BRIDGE at 1400x900 after correcting the rail material from bright oxide red to dark iron; inspected the image against L006. Deck, camber, approach ramps, two river piers, abutments, open railings with diagonal braces, lamps and quay steps are present and readable. L006 supports a low bridge and open railings but not exact span, railing rhythm or 1945 paint; these remain recorded as reconstructed. District fabric around the bridge is intentionally still absent at this stage.

internatio-01.description: Replace Internatio massing with detailed 12-bay facade, stepped towers, blank signage band and reconstructed roof
internatio-01.verification: Saved and reopened-facing checkpoint with 8 Internatio objects. Corrected the provisional massing that crossed Heerenstraat, moving the front to about 4 m behind the south curb. Rebuilt 12-bay facade with tall upper windows, projecting piers, mezzanine band, cornices, small top lights, stepped end towers, reconstructed rear and roof. Facade length compressed to ~84 m (towers included) to better match L004 proportions. Signage is deliberately blank; no lettering copied or invented. Compared side-by-side with L004 crop: silhouette, 12-bay rhythm, tower caps and horizontal banding read correctly. The comparison render temporarily hid the PWD massing and coarse background to inspect the facade; both were restored in the saved .blend. Remaining limitations: flat daylight, blank ground-plane foreground, approximate dimensions and 1945 condition.

singa-01.description: Replace Singa massing with detailed arcaded riverfront, central gabled pavilion, veranda colonnades, tiled roofs, proxy lions and separate blank roof-sign frame
singa-01.verification: Saved and reopened checkpoint. 79 scene objects, 76 owned, 28178 base triangles; 8 Singa meshes. Inspected singa_01.png against L007: central gabled pavilion with 3-bay arcade, 7-bay flanking arcaded wings, upper veranda arches, hipped tiled roofs, blank roof-sign frame and proxy lions read correctly. Fixed inverted ridge-axis-y gable roof winding in palagan_build_lib.py; softened global daylight to sun 1.55, world 1.0, exposure -0.15. Temporary review exclusions of map underlay, BG coarse fabric and F_* massings were restored in the saved scene. Blank signage, proxy lions, exact dimensions and 1945 condition remain reconstructed, not documented.

streets-01.description: Build core typological shophouse rows and sidewalks along eight mapped roads, add Kembang street and fabric overview cameras
streets-01.verification: Recovered the pending operation by deterministic headless rerun of the on-disk build script from the singa-01 checkpoint (GUI MCP socket had stopped executing code; singa-01.blend untouched). Reopened output/working/streets-01.blend: 137 objects (134 owned, 3 preserved baseline), 42 materials, 431258 base triangles, palagan_last_operation=streets-01. Independent footprint validation over 573 front module records found 0 river, 0 road and 0 bridge-keepout violations against the W_KALIMAS polygon, the eight mapped road ribbons and the bridge keepout; 246 rear ranges were validated at build time by the same test. Inspected EEVEE renders of CAM_KEMBANG_STREET, CAM_FABRIC_OVERVIEW, the plan camera with the M001 underlay, and bridgehead/east-approach review cameras: rows follow the mapped roads, the river corridor and bridge crossing align with the underlay, Kembang Djepoen reads as a continuous shophouse street with kerbed sidewalks, and the east bridgehead sits correctly against the Singa arcade and Internatio. Remaining approximations: authored module widths/storeys/colours, blank signboards, authored rear ranges and 414 background terraces, terrace roofs reading continuous along a row, flat daylight and black shopfront glass (materials/lighting deferred to Task 5).

materials-01.description: Rebuild owned material node trees: reflective period glazing, textured clay roofs, asphalt and sett surfaces, muted earth, water sheen; record palette; enable EEVEE raytracing quality
materials-01.verification: Rebuilt 30 PALAGAN-owned material node trees from output/material_palette.json and re-rendered CAM_KEMBANG_STREET and CAM_FABRIC_OVERVIEW (1400x900, EEVEE, map underlay hidden). Inspected before/after crops of the shopfront band: glazing changed from a flat black void to a graduated blue-grey sheen (sampled RGB about 44,51,55 rising with grazing angle) and the interior plane behind it is now a lit warm grey instead of near-black. Facades were rebuilt from the shared plaster texture set with a multiply tint that keeps the texture's tonal detail; the earlier luminance-ramp version had flattened the walls to flat colour. Terrace and landmark roofs now use the clay tile diffuse/rough/normal set at a 5.5 m repeat with a low-frequency weathering multiply so the tile grid does not read as an obvious repeated pattern. Footway setts were desaturated from red brick to grey paving and rescaled from about 0.7 m to about 1.2 m per texture tile. Open ground changed from pale sand to a muted earth-green so empty land no longer reads as desert, and road aggregate/track roughness was added. EEVEE raytracing options raised (screen_trace_quality 0.5, resolution_scale 2, trace_max_roughness 0.55) and taa_render_samples 64. Defects still visible and deferred: shopfront bays remain one unbroken pane per bay because bay mullion geometry is a construction change, and daylight is still flat with no sky gradient. Four materials were skipped because they do not exist in this scene (MAT_ROOF_CLAY, MAT_SINGA_*, etc. resolved where present).

lighting-01.description: Replace flat world with gradient daylight sky, tighten sun disc for readable shadows, set exposure and EEVEE ambient occlusion; render three review views
lighting-01.verification: Replaced the flat single-colour world with a four-stop vertical sky gradient (warm dust-hazed horizon to cool zenith, strength 1.25) driven by the world direction vector, and tightened the sun disc from 9.17 degrees to 2.2 degrees at 3.2 energy, 41 degrees elevation and -132 degrees azimuth, keeping the previous lighting direction. Exposure set to 0.15 with AgX Medium High Contrast and EEVEE fast GI at 6 m for ambient occlusion. Re-rendered CAM_KEMBANG_STREET, CAM_FABRIC_OVERVIEW and CAM_BRIDGE at 1400x900. Inspection: street and eave shadows are now readable instead of washed out, roof tiles catch raking light, the sky reads as a gradient rather than flat grey, and shopfront recesses stay open rather than crushing to black. One real regression found: CAM_BRIDGE no longer sees the bridge because the streets-01 shopfront rows now occupy that camera position, so the render shows a roof; camera positions are therefore deferred to the cameras task and were not silently moved inside a lighting operation. No weather, smoke, fire or battle atmosphere was added.

streets-02.description: Rebuild street fabric with articulated shopfront bays (timber stall risers and mullions), then re-apply the material palette and lighting so the checkpoint carries the full look
streets-02.verification: Rebuilt the street fabric deterministically from the singa-01 checkpoint with articulated shopfronts, then re-applied the material palette (30 materials) and the lighting rig so the checkpoint carries the full look. The shopfront change replaces the single unbroken glazed panel per bay with a timber stall riser (0.14-0.92 m), a capping bead, and glazing divided by mullions into panes of about 1.15 m, with the door opening left clear so no pane fights the door leaf. Plan totals: 327 front modules plus 246 rear ranges (= 573 total module records, consistent with the streets-01 count; the earlier note had reported the combined figure as front-only). Re-rendered CAM_KEMBANG_STREET and CAM_FABRIC_OVERVIEW at 1400x900 and inspected them: the frontage now reads as a row of individual shops with framed windows, timber panels and shop doors, rather than a continuous black band. Paving, roofs, facades and the daylight gradient are carried over. Not verified in this operation: camera positions, which are the next task; CAM_BRIDGE is still occluded by this fabric.

cameras-01.description: Place the required review cameras with explicit positions, targets and purposes; fix the bridge view occluded by the new street fabric; render all six views
cameras-01.verification: Placed the required review cameras from output/camera_setup.json with explicit position, target, lens and purpose stored on each camera object, using a look-at quaternion so the aim is unambiguous. CAM_BRIDGE was moved from the position that the new street fabric had engulfed to stand on the bridge deck at (-58,0,3.4) aimed at (16,0,1); it now shows the deck, kerbs, open railings, lamp standards and both banks. CAM_INTERNATIO_REFERENCE needed three attempts: the first two framings were blocked by background massing and then cropped the building, and it now stands at (-152,138,27) with a 34 mm lens showing the full 12-bay facade, stepped end towers and cornices with foreground blocks acknowledged as occlusion. CAM_SINGA_REFERENCE reads the arcades, central gabled pavilion and blank roof-sign frame from across the river. CAM_DISTRICT_OVERVIEW, CAM_PLAN_CHECK (orthographic, 1650 m) and CAM_KEMBANG_STREET were re-aimed and rendered. All six required views from docs/ART_DIRECTION.md were rendered at 1400x900 and inspected. Remaining issues recorded rather than hidden: the river surface reads too pale in low grazing views because the fresnel sheen mix is too strong, and the plan view shows background blocks as isolated scatter rather than continuous urban frontage.

background-02.description: Densify background urban fabric into coherent blocks with rear ranges, and calm the river fresnel sheen; rebuild and render plan, overview and bridge
background-02.verification: Replaced the scattered background parcels with a coherent parcel grid: frontage pitch 25 m along X and 34 m along Y, widths 23.2-24.8 m so neighbours form a continuous street wall, depths 14-16 m, orientation quantised to 15 degree steps, plus a rear range across a 3.5-5.5 m courtyard on each parcel. Result: 883 background blocks / 1563 authored units, up from 414 / 1443, with skip reasons recorded (overlap 427, intersection 355, rear_overlap 148, water 146, rear_water 4, landmark 41, rear_landmark 4, bridge 3, bank 5). Scene is 134 owned objects and 589,282 base triangles. Also calmed the Kali Mas water: sheen reduced to 0.20-0.235, Fresnel threshold raised to 0.80 so only truly grazing angles reflect, base darkened to a silty green, and ripple strength raised to 0.45 with 0.55 m distance. Re-rendered and inspected CAM_PLAN_CHECK, CAM_DISTRICT_OVERVIEW and CAM_BRIDGE: the plan now reads as blocks fronting lanes rather than isolated scatter, the oblique overview reads as a dense low-rise district with a legible river corridor and crossing, and the pale flat water that previously read as concrete is gone from the bridge view. Remaining limitations: buildings flanking the bridgehead are still the documented F_* approximate massing boxes with no facade detail, and the outer corners of the 650 m radius remain open ground.

handoff-01.description: Final verification of the scene, six deliverable renders, master blend and delivery report
handoff-01.verification: Verified the final scene with verify_12_final.py: 134 owned objects plus 3 preserved baseline objects, 589,282 base and evaluated triangles, 1,180,044 vertices, 42 materials (41 owned), 8 cameras, 2 lights, 11 file-backed images with zero missing files, no NaN or infinite transforms, no zero-scale objects, no mesh objects beyond 2000 m and no material-less owned meshes. Saved output/PALAGAN_Surabaya_Master.blend with operation id handoff-01 and reopened it in Blender 5.2.2 LTS, confirming the same counts and palagan_last_operation=handoff-01. Rendered and inspected the six required views at 1600x1000 with 64 TAA samples (district overview, plan check, bridge, Internatio, Singa, Kembang). Wrote output/DELIVERY_REPORT.md with measured counts, sources per landmark and an explicit list of checks not performed: no interactive GUI inspection in this batch, no Cycles test, no whole-district grazing-angle ground-contact sweep. Noted remaining defects in the report rather than claiming a pass: the F_* bridgehead massings are windowless boxes, water still reads flat at grazing angles, and the outer corners of the district radius are open ground.
